priority: Algorithm comparison, code selection and a unified formal B1 version. Report generation is deferred by explicit user correction.
meaning_of_formal_v1: A versioned, runnable scientific algorithm package with common contracts, supported domain, defaults, failover and independent validation. It is not a claim of real-device or whole-project acceptance.

decisions.RIDE_strength: unknown-reference candidate framework and historical/conditional predictors
decisions.existing_strength: pre-notice-only SafeGBDT, distinct user roles and user-block calibration
decisions.evidence: 20 paired-seed finite comparison favors conditional GBDT over historical mean; selection adds no gain; EV bias remains
decisions.adopt: fixed SafeGBDT plus transparent historical reference with explicit time provenance and native model artifacts
decisions.exclude: signed-bias-only automatic selection; actual-departure/future-session imputation; window calibration presented as pointwise noise

decisions.RIDE_strength: continuous task-stage template with exact interval-average operator
decisions.existing_strength: original rule/DP checks and actual CPOP default-grid strong baseline
decisions.evidence: CPOP stronger at10sec and irregular multi-platform; template slightly better curve RMSE at1min and15min but not all timing metrics
decisions.adopt: CPOP as conservative flexible model, observed-data template admission evaluated on new development/holdout; coarse observations retain original bins and unknown physical timing
decisions.exclude: true-mechanism method selection; coarse-grid CPOP as the only baseline; finite4knot adapter as automatic upgrade

decisions.RIDE_strength: separates latent stage parameters and sampled average process
decisions.existing_strength: explicit threshold/dwell, cumulative versus continuous durations, common raw integrals and recovery/censoring distinctions
decisions.adopt: frozen observed-feature core and untruncated raw request energy; process models cannot manufacture energy gains
decisions.exclude: mixing physical and threshold timing targets; missing-data silent interpolation; participation inferred from threshold alone

decisions.RIDE_strength: multivalued treatment structure, grouped fitting and support diagnostics
decisions.existing_strength: DoubleML-verified AIPW score, nonmonotone candidate sets, user-cluster inference and simple legal baselines
decisions.adopt: standard multivalued AIPW with shared-model comparators; support screening distinct from substantive causal assumptions; binary saturated G1 retained only in its legitimate domain
decisions.exclude: automatic monotone-band tightening; clipped-continuous dose density implementation; claiming diagnostics establish no hidden confounding

decisions.RIDE_strength: independent end-to-end packaging and CSV concepts
decisions.existing_strength: identity/domain validation, data freezes and explicit unavailability
decisions.adopt: self-contained formal modules, bound task-user-meter-reference identity, same-outcome population contract and serializable failure states
decisions.exclude: direct use of the leaking original real-data adapter; dependencies on mutable work Python scripts; silent replacement of B2/B3 interfaces

decisions.existing_strength: separately validated limited graph screening and historical feature studies, including negative evidence
decisions.adopt: preserve previous evidence and optional legacy entry points; learned graphs do not automatically remove required adjustment
decisions.exclude: claiming that this integration solves deep representation, arbitrary causal structure learning or all B1 tasks

validation_rule: Each chosen component must preserve or improve defined correctness. Method routing uses only observed data and declared task conditions; development policy freezes before a new holdout. Unfavorable results retained, no repeated search to force a winner.
preserved: Original RIDE ZIP/source, old scientific results, existing report files, task/, 01_项目依据 and B2/B3 implementations.

final_release.process_policy: guarded: CPOP unless observed-bin validation admits template; raw coarse bins; explicit native-runtime fault fallback
final_release.development_admission: 6 of 6 development seed blocks nonworse and >=1% aggregate improvement; 4.299% observed
final_release.new_holdout: 20 new independent seed blocks, 960 paired variants; all20 improve against conservative baseline; original RIDE remains better at15min
final_release.scope: new unified code and conditional-domain validation; no report updates and no real-device or full-uncertainty claim
